entities.name: Algli
entities.description: A tanner from Innistrad who lost her family to ghouls and became the reborn Liesa's first follower.

entities.name: Liesa
entities.description: A dark-haired angel who warned Algli about the Buried Lord and was reborn.

entities.name: Olutio
entities.description: Man whose daughter suffered a fate like Algli's family; joined her in the ritual and was found dead.

entities.name: Sruta
entities.description: Participant in the ritual, killed by the Buried Lord.

entities.name: Buried Lord
entities.description: A demon the group tried to summon; killed by Liesa using Algli's flame.

events.summary: Ghouls attack and kill Algli's husband and sons; Algli burns down the tannery.
events.quote: resulted in the deaths of her husband and sons

events.summary: Algli, Olutio and Sruta perform a ritual sacrificing a goat to summon the Buried Lord; it fails.
events.quote: sacrificing a goat to summon the Buried Lord

events.summary: Algli meets Liesa, who warns the Buried Lord is a demon.
events.quote: warned her that the Buried Lord was no protector but a demon

events.summary: Algli thrusts her torch into the demon's mouth and Liesa delivers a fatal blow.
events.quote: Liesa used the flame to deliver a final, fatal blow to the Buried Lord.

events.summary: Algli becomes the reborn Liesa's first follower.
events.quote: And thus, Algli became the reborn Liesa's first follower.

relations.quote: Algli became the reborn Liesa's first follower
Liesa used the flame to deliver a final, fatal blow to the Buried Lord.
